name: Risthia Schutzgard
original_name: リスティア・シュッツガルド
source:
Up-and-coming witch at the magic science school. Sara Schroedinger's destined rival, from what it looks like, their rivalries are unusual. Risthia's inventions are causing confusion, mayhem and lots of trouble in the city. Risthia has a disastrous, arrogant, paranoid and domineering personality, the cause to her being like that is probably her tragical past. She had lost her younger sister at an early age, she is obsessed with thinking that she was responsible for her death.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=2784]Getchu[/url].]
